expected_legal_description:
ALL that certain land and premises situate in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden and the State of New Jersey, bounded and described as follows:

BEGINNING at a point in the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West, distant 80 feet Southwestwardly from the intersection of the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West with the Northwesterly line of Chews Landing Road, said point being corner to land of the Borough of Haddonfield; thence

(1) South 64 degrees 22 minutes 25 seconds West along the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West, 299.89 feet to a point; thence

(2) South 25 degrees 37 minutes 35 seconds East at right angles to Kings Highway West 120.68 feet to corner to other land of John J. Litz and Caroline, his wife; thence

(3) South 68 degrees 39 minutes 05 seconds East along said land of Litz, at right angles to Chews Landing Road, 171.43 feet to a point in the Northwesterly line of said Chews Landing Road; thence

(4) North 21 degrees 20 minutes 55 seconds East along the Northwesterly line of Chews Landing Road, 279.48 feet to corner to said land of the Borough of Haddonfield; thence

(5) North 46 degrees 46 minutes 25 seconds West along said land of the Borough of Haddonfield, 59.30 feet to the point and place of beginning.

BEING known as Lot 6, Block 79.01, as shown on the Borough of Haddonfield Tax Map.

COMMONLY known as 26 Chews Landing Road.
